# runzero_scan_template (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero scan template by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the scan template.

### Read-Only

- `acl` (Map of String) A map of IDs to strings which describe how the template may be accessed.
- `agent_id` (String) The agent UUID.
- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the scan template was created.
- `created_by` (String) Email of the user who created the template.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) UUID of the user who created the template.
- `custom_integration_id` (String) The custom integration UUID.
- `description` (String) Description of the scan template.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the scan template is globally accessible.
- `grace_period` (String) Grace period for the scan template.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the scan template is hidden.
- `hosted_zone_id` (String) The hosted zone UUID.
- `name` (String) The name of the scan template.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization UUID.
- `params` (Map of String) Scan template parameters.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent template UUID.
- `recur` (Boolean) Whether the scan template is recurring.
- `recur_frequency` (String) The recurrence frequency.
- `recur_last` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last recurrence.
- `recur_last_task_id` (String) UUID of the last recurring task.
- `recur_next` (Number) Unix timestamp of the next recurrence.
- `site_id` (String) The site UUID.
- `source_id` (String) The source UUID.
- `start_time` (Number) Unix timestamp for the scan start time.
- `status` (String) The status of the scan template.
- `template_id` (String) The base template UUID.
- `type` (String) The type of the scan template.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the scan template was last updated.
